div.div: مُخْدِجٌ (S, A, K,) and مُخْدِجَةٌ (TA) A she-camel bringing forth her young one imperfectly formed, even if the period of gestation be complete: (S, A, K, TA:) or bringing forth her young one completely formed before the proper time of bringing forth. (TA. [See also خَادِجٌ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
